summary.tagline: Geirangerfjorden (Norwegian) or Geiranger Fjord (English) is a fjord in the Sunnmøre region of Møre og Romsdal

days.title: Villages and Southern Slopes
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Geiranger
stops.detail: At the end of the Geirangerfjord, about 100 km from the coastline, lies the village of Geiranger.

stops.name: Skageflå
stops.detail: The Skageflå farm is located on the south side of the Geirangerfjord at approximately 250 m above sea level.

stops.name: Homlong
stops.detail: Hay was dried on the meadows, which was lowered to the fjord by wire rope winches and from there brought by boat to Homlong on the Geirangerfjord.

days.title: High Farms and Waterfalls
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Blomberg
stops.detail: The Blomberg farm is located on the south side of the Geirangerfjord at approximately 452 m above sea level.

stops.name: Knivsflå
stops.detail: The Knivsflå farm is located on the north side of the Geirangerfjord at approximately 250 m above sea level near the "Seven Sisters" waterfall.

stops.name: Die sieben Schwestern
stops.detail: Worth seeing are the waterfalls "The Seven Sisters" (Norwegian: De syv søstre) or the waterfalls Freier, Brautschleier, Ljosurfossen, Bringefossen, Gjerdefossen or Grinddalsfossen.
